verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only one API authentication scheme: HTTP Basic with a publishable key and a secret key. The same keys are used for the API, MCP and Chat API, and nothing shows scoped, read-only or analytics-only credentials that withhold send permissions. Agent safety guidance about API keys is an adjacent feature, not scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
